title: Fields of the World Benchmark Data
description: Training and evaluation chips for field boundary delineation models: Sentinel-2 imagery paired with instance and semantic label masks, cut from harmonized (fiboa) field boundary data by Fields of the World. Each collection is one country or region with train, validation and test splits. Start with the [agent guide](AGENTS.md).

links.title: Fields of The World: A Machine Learning Benchmark Dataset For Global Agricultural Field Boundary Segmentation
